Messages.Author: CYLee
Messages.Body:
I have a question about the number of times you can use a weapon
and hawg in an entire combat. Are weapons like Chainsaw,which states
`usable only once per combat' and hawg, `1 press each turn' usable only once
for an entire combat or are they usable once every combat round?
A couple of more question, is tapping a master card considered
playing a master card and can you remove blood from Investments
(short,long and protracted) if you don't have any master cards and you
tap a master card in the same turn. BTW, can u tap a master card OOT?
(Ok, 3 more questions, I was bluffing, so bleed me! ;-D) Thanks to anyone
who can help me.

A Jyhad caitiff, :-)

Messages.Author: Bob Ellison
Messages.Body:
> I have a question about the number of times you can use a weapon
> and hawg in an entire combat. Are weapons like Chainsaw,which states
> `usable only once per combat' and hawg, `1 press each turn' usable only once
> for an entire combat or are they usable once every combat round?

A "turn" is a Methuselah's entire turn. A Hawg is essentially tapped once
it is used for a press.

> A couple of more question, is tapping a master card considered
> playing a master card

No, unless the card says so.

> and can you remove blood from Investments
> (short,long and protracted) if you don't have any master cards and you
> tap a master card in the same turn.

Yes. You may take blood from a single Investment instead of *playing* a
Master card on your turn. Tapping a Master card is not the same as
playing it.

> BTW, can u tap a master card OOT?

Yes, if the card gives an effect that makes sense when it is not your
turn.. It doesn't make sense to tap the Gangrel card Backways when it is
not your turn, but you can certainly tap the Mob to press any combat
you're in, even if it isn't your own turn.

papillo the meticulous

Messages.Body:

>> I have a question about the number of times you can use a weapon

>> `usable only once per combat' and hawg, `1 press each turn' usable only once
>> for an entire combat or are they usable once every combat round?
>
>A "turn" is a Methuselah's entire turn. A Hawg is essentially tapped once

Not in this case: It's a combat turn. The Hawg will generate a press at
the "press" part of every turn the combat lasts.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
pap...@fc.hp.com (Bob Ellison) writes:

>> I have a question about the number of times you can use a weapon
>> and hawg in an entire combat. Are weapons like Chainsaw,which states
>> `usable only once per combat' and hawg, `1 press each turn' usable only once
>> for an entire combat or are they usable once every combat round?

>A "turn" is a Methuselah's entire turn. A Hawg is essentially tapped once
>it is used for a press.

Except that it untaps during every Methuselah's untap phase, not just yours
(if you want to think of it as tapping at all, which is a fine idea.)

And, just to be clear:
It doesn't untap if you (somehow) untap the vamp in the middle of
a turn, of course.

Sorry, but there is no such thing as a combat turn.
Combats have rounds.
Minions have actions.
Methuselahs have turns.

Tom's official answer to the question was: once per Methuselah turn, as
stated on the card.
